answer: Proof-of-stake consensus functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital to earn influence. This creates a signal of skin-in-the-game that forces an attacker to purchase majority stake, a feat as difficult as navigating a gale. Should an entity attempt to forge identities, the cost of acquiring sufficient network value exceeds the potential gain, leaving the raven of systemic collapse to feed only on those who lack authentic economic commitments.
